test_cases.expected: HTTP 200 with disk list (names, ids, status, size)

test_cases.expected: HTTP 200 with disk list filtered by status

test_cases.name: SDK Fallback List EVS Disks
test_cases.command: python3 -c "import os; from huaweicloudsdkcore.auth.credentials import BasicCredentials; from huaweicloudsdkevs.v2.region.evs_region import EvsRegion; from huaweicloudsdkevs.v2 import EvsClient, ListVolumesRequest; c=EvsClient.new_builder().with_credentials(BasicCredentials(os.getenv('HUAWEICLOUD_SDK_AK'),os.getenv('HUAWEICLOUD_SDK_SK'))).with_region(EvsRegion.value_of('cn-north-4')).build(); r=c.list_volumes(ListVolumesRequest(limit=25)); print('SDK OK, disks:', [v.name for v in (r.volumes or [])])"
test_cases.expected: SDK returns the same disk list
